name: SmileBack API Patterns
description: The SmileBack tool surface as exposed through Conduit: the 12 read-only tools over the Data Replication API v3, the five-header credential (OAuth2 password grant run by the server), the US/EU region, Conduit access tiers (all read, none admin-gated), limit/offset pagination, response truncation, client-side filtering because the API has no per-company or date-range filter, the error vocabulary, and the personal data the responses carry.
